title: Maria and Her Cards
text:
Maria has a box of flashcards. Each card has a word on one side and a picture on the other side. She reads the word and says it out loud.

Every day, Maria looks at the cards for ten minutes. She likes the red cards best. Now she knows many new words.

questions.text: What is on one side of each card?
How long does Maria look at the cards every day?
Why does Maria say the words out loud?
What can you guess about Maria now?
options: She does not like the cards.

vocabulary.definition: a drawing or photo that shows something
units of time, with sixty seconds in each

paragraph_translations: Maria ma pudełko z fiszkami. Każda fiszka ma słowo po jednej stronie i obrazek po drugiej. Ona czyta słowo i mówi je na głos.
Każdego dnia Maria ogląda fiszki przez dziesięć minut. Najbardziej lubi czerwone fiszki. Teraz zna wiele nowych słów.
